svg.desc: Two sections through the macula. Left, dry age-related macular degeneration: yellow drusen deposits between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch membrane, and a patch where the pigment epithelium, photoreceptors and choriocapillaris have wasted away. Right, wet age-related macular degeneration: new vessels from the choroid break through Bruch membrane and leak fluid and blood under the retina.

g.title: Blood under the retina and RPE
